obligations.note: The change sets payments PRIVILEGED_IDLE_MINUTES and payments.privileged_idle_minutes to 16, which breaches the catalog bound payments.privileged_idle_minutes <= 15. No valid exception covers this deviation.

The change relies on EXC-0184, but that exception is scoped to component mortgage.session, not payments.session. The only payments.session exception, EXC-0141, expired on 2026-09-08, before the review time of 2026-10-08.

Ticket CHG-26996 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim at 2026-10-04T00:27Z, before the change opened. Its components cover both touched components: payments.policy (policy.py) and payments.controls-data (policy-params.json).
The code_review approval is from Sofia Santos, a change_approver for payments. She is a different person from the author, Linh Nguyen.
The change has a single commit, and both approvals name head commit f72ea533.

run.json reports success on head from ci-runner-01. The attached JUnit report, however, is timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time, and was produced on host dev-laptop-7.local. It also shows the SES-1 control test passing against a 16-minute value. So it is unclear that this report comes from the change's own CI run on the final commit.
The change edits protected path controls/payments/policy-params.json. It carries a control_owner approval on head from Rachel Stein (controls-office), who is outside the author's team (payments-eng).
No acceptance-ledger entry covers apps/baseline-payments/payments/policy.py or the changed parameter, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1447 raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, which violates the SES-1 bound of at most 15 minutes. The risk acceptance it cites, EXC-0184, is scoped to mortgage.session and so does not cover payments. The payments SES-1 exception, EXC-0141, has expired. In addition, the CI evidence is inconsistent: the JUnit report postdates the review and came from a local workstation. The change is rejected.
